title: 第2章 你是真心爱朕吗？
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
喝还是不喝？

    这是秦然现在面对的问题。

    鲛人泪这种奇毒，虽然不能一次直接毁掉他根基，但也会造成损伤。

    如今穿越而来，后续肯定免不了修炼，此刻若是把毒喝下去，那势必会给未来造成不小的麻烦。

    可在夜弦月的火热目光下，怎么才能不喝呢？

    秦然绞尽脑汁。

    “爱妃，你刚说这杯酒叫什么名字？”

    “美人血~”

    “唉！可惜了，这名字朕很不喜欢！美人是用来宠的，怎么能用这个名字来为酒命名呢？”

    秦然慵懒地一挥手。

    “青符，去把朕珍藏的酒拿来，朕要和月妃喝到天明！”

    “是，陛下。”老太监恭敬退去。

    夜弦月笑容如常。

    但笑容深处，藏着一抹不易察觉的冰冷之色。

    “陛下，这酒是臣妾亲自为您酿的，您若不喜欢它的名字，那换个名字就好了，您觉得叫美人醉怎么样？”

    不等秦然回答。

    夜弦月已抬起酒杯，将杯中红色液体慢慢朝他口中倒去。

    “等等！”

    眼看着杯中酒就要进嘴里了，秦然赶忙开口。

    “怎么了？陛下。”

    夜弦月娇笑着。

    秦然强压心中忐忑，脸上露出了一抹色眯眯的笑。

    “既然美人恩推脱不掉，那这酒朕喝就是了，不过却不能用杯子喝。”

    “那陛下想怎么喝呢~~”

    “爱妃，你猜？”

    “别闹了陛下，您是天子，臣妾哪能揣测到您的心思～”

    “呵呵。”

    秦然搂着女人的纤腰，抬起两根手指，在她红唇间轻轻摸过。

    “爱妃喂朕！用嘴！”

    夜弦月一愣，但随即笑靥如花，眼底有着不易察觉的讥讽。

    “既然陛下开口了，那臣妾遵命就是。”

    酒杯调转方向，凑到红唇边上。

    女人红唇微张，杯中深红色液体朝口中慢慢倒去……

    秦然忽然笑了。

    “爱妃，今早发生了一件有趣的事，你帮朕解解惑？”

    夜弦月口中含酒，没法开口，但眼神没有拒绝的意思。
content_en:
To drink or not to drink?

This is the problem Qin Ran is facing now.

Although the strange poison of Merman's Tears cannot directly destroy his foundation at once, it can still cause damage.

Now that you have traveled through time, you will definitely need to practice in the future. If you drink the poison now, it will definitely cause a lot of trouble in the future.

But under Ye Xianyue's fiery gaze, how could he not drink?

Kieran racked his brains.

"My beloved, what was the name of this glass of wine you just mentioned?"

"Beauty blood~"

"Alas! What a pity, I don't like this name very much! Beauty is meant to be pampered, so how can you name a wine with this name?"

Kieran waved his hand lazily.

"Qing Fu, go and get the wine I have collected. I will drink it with Concubine Yue until dawn!"

"Yes, Your Majesty." The old eunuch bowed respectfully.

Ye Xianyue smiled as usual.

But deep in the smile, there was a hint of coldness that was hard to detect.

"Your Majesty, I personally brewed this wine for you. If you don't like its name, just change it. What do you think of calling the beauty drunk?"

Without waiting for Kieran to answer.

Ye Xianyue had raised the wine glass and slowly poured the red liquid in the glass into his mouth.

"Wait!"

Seeing that the wine in the glass was about to enter his mouth, Qin Ran hurriedly spoke.

"What's wrong? Your Majesty."

Ye Xianyue smiled coquettishly.

Qin Ran suppressed the anxiety in his heart and showed a sly smile on his face.

"Since I can't shirk the beauty's kindness, I can just drink this wine, but I can't drink it from a cup."

"Then how do you want to drink, Your Majesty~~"

"My beloved concubine, what do you think?"

"Stop making trouble, Your Majesty, you are the emperor, how can I guess your thoughts~"

"Haha."

Kieran hugged the woman's slender waist, raised two fingers, and gently touched her red lips.

"Fei Fei, feed me! Use your mouth!"

Ye Xianyue was stunned for a moment, but then she smiled like a flower, with an imperceptible sarcasm in her eyes.

"Since His Majesty has spoken, I will obey your orders."

The wine glass turned around and brought it to her red lips.

The woman's red lips opened slightly, and the dark red liquid in the cup slowly poured into her mouth...

Qin Ran suddenly smiled.

"My dear concubine, something interesting happened this morning. Can you help me to understand it?"

Ye Xianyue had wine in her mouth and couldn't speak, but her eyes didn't mean to refuse.
